CloudBites — Good Food, Zero Detours

The original prompt, shown in full as plain text.

Prompt

Create a food delivery landing page for a virtual kitchen brand called "CloudBites" that operates delivery-only. Include these sections:

1. HERO SECTION
- Bold headline: "Restaurant-Quality Food, Delivered Fast"
- Subheadline: "Fresh, chef-crafted meals at your door in 30 minutes or less"
- Address/ZIP input with "See Menu" button
- Delivery time estimate based on location
- Hero image: Appetizing food spread or delivery packaging

2. HOW IT WORKS (3 steps)
- Step 1: Enter your address
- Step 2: Browse our menu and order
- Step 3: Enjoy fresh food delivered to you
- Clean icons for each step

3. MENU CATEGORIES PREVIEW
- Visual grid of cuisine types offered
- Categories: Burgers, Asian Fusion, Healthy Bowls, Pizza, Desserts
- Each with enticing image and "Order Now" overlay on hover
- "View Full Menu" CTA

4. WHY CHOOSE US
- 30-Minute Delivery Guarantee
- Restaurant-Quality Ingredients
- Eco-Friendly Packaging
- Real-Time Order Tracking
- Each with icon and short description

5. POPULAR ITEMS CAROUSEL
- 6-8 bestselling dishes
- Image, name, rating, price, "Add to Cart" button
- "Most Ordered" and "New" badges

6. DELIVERY ZONES MAP
- Interactive map showing delivery radius
- Check if address is in delivery zone
- Display estimated delivery time by zone

7. APP DOWNLOAD SECTION
- "Get $10 Off Your First Order"
- App Store and Google Play buttons
- Phone mockup showing the app
- QR code for quick download

8. TRUST SIGNALS
- Customer ratings (4.8/5 from 10,000+ orders)
- Partner logos (DoorDash, Uber Eats, etc. if applicable)
- Food safety certification badges

9. FOOTER
- Links: Menu, About, Careers, Partner With Us
- Contact info and hours
- Social media links
- Terms, Privacy, Allergen Info

Design: Modern, energetic with vibrant food colors. Primary: #FF6B35 (orange). Fast-loading, mobile-optimized. High-quality food photography essential. Prominent CTAs throughout.
